verses.1: And you set up a shrine for the kings of Israel.
verses.2: And you said, “What is your mother like? She lives among the mountains of Rabtza, in a place filled with many trees.”
verses.3: And one of them climbed up from their nests, like a bird. It learned how to prey on humans.
verses.4: And nations heard of him in their distress. They captured him and brought him back to Egypt.
verses.5: And it became clear that her prayer was wasted on account of her negligence. She took one of her household members and executed him as punishment.
verses.6: And he walked among the stars like a wild animal. He learned how to hunt humans and eat them.
verses.7: And they knew their enemies and destroyed their cities. The land was filled with their cries of despair.
verses.8: And the nations around him gave him gifts from their countries. They spread their rules upon him through their conquests.
verses.9: And it was placed in a chest, and it was brought before King Babylon. It was brought to him so that his voice might not be heard anymore among the people of Israel.
verses.10: Your branches were like vines in your waters; they were lush and full of leaves. They grew from the many waters.
verses.11: And she had strong arms, enough to hold up the weights. Her strength was so great that she could lift heavy objects. She saw her own strength in all its glory.
verses.12: And they were thrown into the earth in flames. The fragrance of the flowers was destroyed; they withered away. A fire consumed them completely.
verses.13: And now, they shall dwell in the desert, in the land of Zieh and Tsama.
verses.14: And fire came from the pot in her hands. It ate everything, and there was no longer any place for birds to nest there. It became a place where no birds could live anymore.
